title: overlay_check's Demo_Replay literal still omits growth_on — the same B1 residual-site class one field up from the r3 fix
evidence:
cfg := Demo_Replay{
		name = d.name,
		use_fixture = d.use_fixture,
		qos_fixture = d.qos_fixture,
		advance_gate_on = d.advance_gate_on, // 6.2 r2 W2: the B1 flag-threading's residual site — the overlay verb re-sims the gate demos gate-ON too, or its verification frame shows the wrong sim
		session = {goal = d.win_goal, cap_ms = d.lose_cap_ms, health_on = d.health_on, surge_win_pct = d.surge_win_pct},
	}
---
harness/run.odin:642: state.growth_enabled = cfg.growth_on // 5.1: run setup — re-created identically on every replay
---
demos/growth.dem:32: growth on

demos/node_health.dem:30: growth on

demos/terminal_types.dem:24: growth on
detail: demo_apply_setup applies cfg.growth_on (default false), so `harness overlay` on the three growth demos re-sims growth-OFF — a silent wrong verification frame, the exact R2-W1 defect class at the literal the fold just touched. Pre-existing from 5.1; manual PP_DEBUG verb, no CI/golden impact.
recommended_fix: Add `growth_on = d.growth_on` to overlay_check's cfg literal, mirroring run.odin:281/696.

title: The new fire-tick pin hardcodes 600 instead of reading cat.balance.advance.milestone_window_ticks — spurious failure on a fixture retune below 600, under-pinning above it
evidence:
testing.expect(t, fire_tick >= 600, "the gated scripted advance must fire at the window (>= 600), not at the scripted tick 100")
---
core/determinism_test.odin:120: milestone_window_ticks = 600,
detail: The pin's assertion boundary duplicates the fixture window as a magic literal. A test_catalog retune below 600 fails the test spuriously; above 600, an early-fire regression between 600 and the real window escapes the pin.
recommended_fix: Assert fire_tick >= u64(cat.balance.advance.milestone_window_ticks) — the test already holds `cat`, removing the hidden coupling.
